# Noillirk Answers

> An independent English guide to PlayDaily's seven-round Noillirk Daily, with hints, scored answers and an archive organized by UTC puzzle date.

Match the UTC date and prompt before citing an answer. Daily sheets label the evidence available for that board: verified results, partially verified results or a third-party report. When a daily board is pending, the homepage offers original practice rounds.

## Daily sheets

- [Today's sheet](https://noillirkanswers.app/): Open hints and reveal answers for the current UTC puzzle when available.
- [Answer archive](https://noillirkanswers.app/archive/): Find past sheets by date or by words in a prompt.

## Guides

- [How to play](https://noillirkanswers.app/how-to-play/): Round timing, scoring tiers and the daily reset.
- [Hint guide](https://noillirkanswers.app/hints/): Use clues and first-letter hints before revealing an answer.
- [Krillion vs Noillirk](https://noillirkanswers.app/krillion-vs-noillirk/): Compare how the two games score popular and rare answers.

## Official game

- [PlayDaily Noillirk](https://playdaily.org/noillirk): Play the daily puzzle and consult the original rules.
